title: SYNTHETIC: Office application spawned encoded PowerShell
description: SYNTHETIC. EDR alert on host WS-FIN-042: WINWORD.EXE spawned powershell.exe -NoP -W Hidden -enc SQBFAFgAIAAoAE4AZQB3AC0A under user jdoe. Seconds later the host connected to 203.0.113.45 on port 443 and resolved cdn-update[.]example. A file dropped to C:\Users\jdoe\AppData\Local\Temp\upd.dll has MD5 0987ace2bf850aacc7630a3b8aacfc40.
